BiblicalUsage: Choser is lack, the want of all things, and it is the curse of a people who forsake God. Amos says God gave cleanness of teeth, want of bread, in all their cities, and Deuteronomy says the disobedient shall serve their enemies in hunger and thirst and nakedness and want of all things, even to eating in secret during the siege.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe want is the fruit of turning from God, and the curse is written plainly so that we will turn back. I hold that the God who sends the want is the same God who promises the return, and that is where hope lives.
